messages:
Mira Shah: Quick heads-up — I noticed the runtime quickstart page has an embedded curl example that points at /v1/legacy-generate and the staging preview shows a 404 for the snippet iframe. Who owns the runtime quickstart doc now? @eng-docs?

Alex Chen: docs-bot flagged this earlier today — looks like an orphaned snippet anchor (`#example-stream`) and the curl endpoint is outdated. We should switch the sample to the new `/v1/generate` shape and remove the iframe preview or rehost it. :eyes:

Alex Chen: example change (inline): `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-1.0","input":"hello"}'` — replaces the legacy call.

Sam Ortiz: I can open a tiny PR to update the snippet and swap the endpoint. Will also run the staging preview after. If someone can confirm the correct asset host for screenshots (cdn vs assets.redwood.ai) I'll update image links too.

Elaine Wu: We rehosted a bunch of runbook screenshots to `assets.redwood.ai` last quarter for compliance, so prefer that. For small inline images a rehost is fine; for large diagrams we keep them on the diagram bucket.

Jamal Patel: pinging @eng-infra for the doc asset whitelist — can we serve previews from `assets.redwood.ai` in staging? If yes, Sam, go ahead. If not, we should stub the iframe and mark the preview as TODO.

docs-bot: link-scan report: 3 broken anchors found in `docs/runtime/quickstart.md` (anchors: `#example-stream`, `#kv-cache-notes`, `#quick-batching`) — automated suggestion: add redirect anchors or correct targets.

Sam Ortiz: thanks — I'll: 1) update curl snippet to `/v1/generate`, 2) replace the iframe with a static code block + screenshot hosted on `assets.redwood.ai`, 3) add short note about schema v2 and link to /docs/reference/schema-v2. Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 :+1:

Mira Shah: perfect, thanks Sam. Can you tag me and Alex on the PR for a quick review? I'll check the microcopy and runtime notes.

Alex Chen: happy to review — will look at the batching note while I'm there. If helpful, add a one-liner in the changelog section so folks running internal examples know to switch endpoints.

Sam Ortiz: will do. I'll add a tiny migration note and mark the anchors with redirects so the link-scan clears. ETA: PR in 30–45m.

Mira Shah: great — closing loop here. If anyone else sees other quickstart broken bits, drop them in this thread or comment on the PR. Thanks! :raised_hands:
